description: Cartografia de Riscos Naturais - Suscetibilidade à ocorrência de Emanações Gasosas Permanentes - Região Autónoma dos Açores (RAA) is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores . The mapping of susceptibility to the occurrence of gaseous emanations, which includes the studies carried out on fumarolic events and diffuse degassing, was drawn up for the Regional Directorate for the Environment (XII Regional Government of the Azores) and the Azores Seismic Information and Surveillance Centre, as part of the study ‘Assessment of geological hazards ... Coverage: Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores . The portal shows the English title as "Cartography of Natural Hazards - Susceptibility to the occurrence of Permanent Gas Emanations - Autonomous Region of the" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores . Its keywords include hvd, observacao-da-terra-e-do-ambiente, furnas, santa-cruz-da-graciosa, praia-de-almoxarife, temperatura-no-solo. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
